result:
All 14 queries ran and returned plausible answers. I checked T12 and T13 by hand against `orders.csv`, and the rest only against the data.

Three things you may want to know:
- **T3, T7, T10:** these return maps, and qlang prints map keys as keywords (`:db 3`). I didn't convert them to strings because every map key is a keyword.
- **T8:** keys of the merged dependencies come out as keywords. I turned them into strings with `print | drop 1`, which works for these simple names but would break on a quoted key like `:"two words"`.
- **T1, T2, T4, T5, T6, T7, T8, T9, T10, T11:** the leading `/` in these needed `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1` in Git Bash.

T1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | * /name | sort ~(lower)
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce null | at :country | coalesce "unknown") | * count
T4: /data/users | * (at :profile | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * /labels | flat | * (/name | lower) | distinct | sort
T6: | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce null | at :login)}
T7: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | * count
T8: :dev /devDependencies | /dependencies | union dev | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) | * ([(/0 | print | drop 1) "@" /1] | join "")
T9: /services | filter ~(allOf (at :enabled | eq true) (/port | gt 8000)) | * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: | lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(split " " | /2) | * count
T11: | lines | * (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | flat | * (drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: | lines | drop 1 | * split "," | filter ~(allOf (/5 | lower | eq "shipped") (/4 | ne "")) | * ({:q (/3 | parseJson) :p (/4 | parseJson)} | mulOf /q /p) | sum | round 2
T13: | lines | drop 1 | * split "," | filter ~(allOf (/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") (/4 | ne "")) | * {:c (/1) :t ({:q (/3 | parseJson) :p (/4 | parseJson)} | mulOf /q /p)} | groupBy ~(/c) | * (* /t | sum | round 2) | entries | * {:customer (/0 | print | drop 1) :total /1} | sort ~([(/total | desc)]) | take 2
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
